title: Making a bookcase / What are you going to do?
subtitle: 做书架 / 你打算做什么？

lead.question: 听录音前先想：乔治在作坊里敲敲打打，丹过来问「你在干什么」「你打算把它漆成什么颜色」。这两句里其实藏着两种时态——此刻正在做，和打算马上做。你能分清吗？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象乔治在干活，丹走过来问「你在干什么」「你打算把它漆成什么颜色」。这里有两层时态：此刻正在做（现在进行时 I'm making）和即将打算做（be going to I'm going to paint it）。be going to 表「打算、准备、按计划要做」。带着这个区别去听第 37 课。
goals: 能用 be going to + 动词原形 表打算/计划/即将发生
区分现在进行时（此刻）与 be going to（将来打算）
认识工具与动作词：work, hard, make, bookcase, hammer, paint, pink, favourite
会用 Which ...? 选择、Here you are. 递物
lead.summary: 第 37 课是丹和乔治在作坊里：乔治在做书架，丹递锤子，两人聊「你打算把它漆成什么颜色」——引出 be going to（打算）。第 38 课把 What are you going to do?（打算）与 What are you doing now?（此刻）对比操练，巩固将来打算与现在进行时的区别。
lead.tips: ① be going to = am/is/are going to + 动词原形，表打算/计划/预言；② 否定在 be 后加 not（is not going to）；疑问把 be 提前（Is George going to ...?）；③ 区别：I'm making（此刻进行）vs I'm going to paint it（将来打算）；④ work hard 努力干；paint it pink 中 pink 是形容词作宾语补足语；⑤ favourite 英式拼写，美式 favorite。

questions.q: What's the difference between "I'm making a bookcase" and "I'm going to paint it"?
questions.zh: I'm making a bookcase 和 I'm going to paint it 有什么区别？
questions.a: Am/is/are + v-ing describes an action happening right now; am/is/are going to + verb describes an intention or plan for the near future. George is making it now, but he plans to paint it later.
questions.aZh: 现在进行时描述此刻正在做；be going to 描述近期打算/计划。乔治此刻在做书架，但打算稍后漆它。
questions.hint: 一个在「进行」，一个在「打算」。

questions.q: What are you going to do? — I'm going to shave. / What are you doing now? — I'm shaving. / What are you going to do? — I'm going to wait for a bus. / What are you doing now? — I'm waiting for a bus.
questions.zh: 第 38 课操练：What are you going to do?（打算）与 What are you doing now?（此刻）对比，各问一遍。
questions.a: What are you going to do? — I'm going to do my homework. / What are you doing now? — I'm doing my homework.
questions.aZh: 你打算做什么？——我打算做作业。/ 你此刻在做什么？——我在做作业。
questions.hint: be going to + 原形表打算；be + v-ing 表现在进行。

grammar.title: 将来时 be going to（构成）
grammar.structure: am / is / are + going to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: be going to 由 be 的现在时形式加 going to 再加动词原形构成，表示「打算、准备」在最近做某事。
grammar.usage: 表主观打算或近期计划。

examples.en: He is going to paint the bookcase tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他准备明天给书架刷漆。

grammar.title: be going to 的用法（打算 / 计划 / 预言）
grammar.structure: 表意图：be going to + 原形；表预言：It's going to rain!
grammar.definition: A 表示「打算、准备」做某事；B 表示按计划/安排要发生；C 表示预言某事即将发生（It's going to rain!）。非正式语体多用 be going to 而非 will。
grammar.usage: 表达意图、安排或即将发生的事。

examples.en: What are you going to do now?

grammar.title: be going to 的疑问与否定
grammar.structure: 疑问：Be + 主语 + going to + 原形?；否定：主语 + be + not + going to + 原形
grammar.definition: 把 be 提前构成一般疑问句；在 be 后加 not 构成否定。

examples.en: Is George going to paint it pink?
examples.zh: 乔治打算把它刷成粉红色吗？

examples.en: George is not going to paint it pink.
examples.zh: 乔治不打算把它刷成粉红色。
